annotation.bound_parties_text: Local governments and relevant departments of the State Council (各地方各有关部门), government organs, public institutions and state-owned enterprises, and the National Development and Reform Commission are directed to implement the opinions.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 各地方各有关部门要在党中央集中统一领导下，强化协同配合，加大场景培育和开放力度，结合实际抓好贯彻落实。政府机关、事业单位和国有企业要强化示范引领。
